tmp:2053: nekudah im vav — the melupum vowel-sign pictured as a point with a vav, symbolizing Yosef the ruler drawing from Chokhmah (yud-point) and Binah (vav-river)
tmp:2055: nikra'im chakhamim — being called 'wise ones': the title sages earn for silently enduring strife and insults (the geese shedding their feathers) without responding
tmp:2056: ner — the candle/lamp as symbol of the soul (nefesh), per 'the candle of Hashem is the soul of man' (Prov 20:27), whose merged flames produce light and joy
tmp:2057: kiyum ha-sekhel — the sustaining/maintenance of the intellect, kept alive like a burning lamp by bodily moisture preserved via the lungs, enabling trust (bitachon)
tmp:2058: ner dolek — a burning/lit candle as image of the intellect, whose flame is fueled by the body's moisture guarded by the lungs against the heart's heat
tmp:2059: nasa libo et raglav — 'his heart carried his feet' (Bereishit Rabbah 70): dancing driven by the spirit in the heart, via the tzaddik, nullifying arrogance and idolatry
tmp:2060: devekut shel adam ba-Ein Sof — a person's mystical cleaving to the Infinite (Ein Sof), a state of nullified awareness that must alternate 'running and returning' to preserve his existence
tmp:2065: atzot ha-nachash — the counsels of the primordial Serpent that Chavah received, an act of 'marriage' (hishi'ani/nisu'in) through which the Serpent injected pollution (zuhama) into her
tmp:2066: ke-shemekabblin etzot me-resha'im — the act/state of receiving counsel from the wicked, which constitutes a union ('marriage') with the kelipah, opposite of receiving tzaddikim's counsel
tmp:2067: nisu'in ba-kelipah — 'marriage within the husk': the illicit spiritual union effected by accepting the wicked's counsel, modeled on 'the Serpent hishi'ani' read as language of marriage
tmp:2068: nishlam ha-dibbur le-shalom — the completion of the speech of peace: through Shabbat-eating delight speech attains peace, unlike the mute peace of a weekday fast ('they could not speak to him peaceably')
tmp:2069: simchat ha-mitzvah — joy in performing a mitzvah, which completes holiness and raises the vitality trapped in the kelipot (the eleven incense spices), enabling grasp of the unattainable
tmp:2070: nishlam ha-Torah — [here: charity being completed/illuminated on Shabbat] the completion/shining of tzedakah through Shabbat as emunah ('sun on Shabbat is charity for the poor')
tmp:2071: Shabbat she-hu bechinot emunah — Shabbat identified as the aspect of faith (emunah), testifying to God's unity and creation, through which tzedakah is completed and shines
tmp:2072: ke-she-nishlam ha-da'at — the state when Da'at (knowledge/awareness) is perfected, whereby all lacks are remedied ('if you acquired da'at, what do you lack?'), ending troubles and exile
tmp:2073: nishlam kol ha-chesronot — the remedying/completion of all deficiencies that follows the perfection of Da'at, since troubles, suffering and exile exist only in proportion to lack of Da'at
tmp:2074: nishlam pigmei ha-yirah — the repair/completion of the blemishes of fear (yirah) achieved by returning honor (kavod) to its root in fear, which then yields peace
tmp:2075: mesame'ach et atzmo be-Elokav — the practice of gladdening oneself in one's God, the tikkun that completes all lacks stemming from the Shattering of the Vessels and elevates fallen sparks
tmp:2077: neshamah le-ha'am — the true sage as the 'soul' of the people below him: he is the essence (bone) and the people are the flesh, broken by hearing his sighing voice
tmp:2079: kol ha-tov — 'all the good': the principle that all goodness in existence is nothing but the souls of Israel, including good held captive among the nations
tmp:2080: nishmot Yisrael — the souls of Israel, identified as the totality of all good, portions of which lie captive within the nations and draw converts back to Israel's faith
tmp:2081: ke-she-shome'a mi-peh ha-tzaddik — hearing Torah directly from the tzaddik's mouth as the aspect of 'nishma' (we will hear), the crown Israel retained, unlike book-study (na'aseh)
tmp:2082: bimei Rabban Gamliel — the generation of Rabban Gamliel, whose Torah was in the aspect of 'nishma'/prayer, hence they learned Torah standing (amidah = prayer)
tmp:2083: ha-nistarot la-Shem Elokeinu — the verse 'The hidden things belong to the Lord our God' (Deut 29:28), expounded as the aspect of 'nishma' versus the revealed 'na'aseh'
tmp:2084: nishmar min talmidim she-einam hagunim — being guarded from unworthy students: the protective function of a Torah scholar's ordinary conversation ('ve-alehu li-terufah' — to permit the mouth)
tmp:2085: nishtaneh ha-teva — the changing/overriding of nature through prayer (the 18 blessings of the Amidah), nullifying the philosophers' 'nature, mother of all life (chai)'
tmp:2086: nishtanah panav le-khamah gevanin — the face changing to many colors in shame, symbolized by the vav within the alef as the firmament (fire-and-water) comprising all hues
tmp:2088: ribui ha-mitzvot — the abundance/multitude of mitzvot ('even Israel's sinners are full of mitzvot as a pomegranate'), whose collective light of joy overpowers the anxiety of sin
tmp:2089: nitbatel ha-de'agah shel ha-chet — the nullification of sin-anxiety that had blocked joy, dissolved by the blazing light of joy from one's many mitzvot, enabling confession
tmp:2091: nitbatel ha-cherpah ha-shorah al libo — the annulment of the disgrace resting on one's heart ('disgrace broke my heart,' Ps 69) by binding the heart to its timely point of holiness
tmp:2092: nitbatel ha-ka'as ve-ha-akhzariut — the nullification of anger and cruelty through expanded Da'at, which multiplies peace ('the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, for the earth is full of knowledge')
tmp:2095: mitzvat mezuzah — the commandment of mezuzah, through which the craving for money is annulled (Shaddai = 'Who said dai/enough,' contentment with one's portion)
tmp:2096: nitbatel machshevot akum — the annulment of idolatrous/foreign thoughts through hand-clapping in prayer, which places one in the atmosphere of the Land of Israel ('as one who has a God')
tmp:2097: she-al yedei ha-tzaddik — [in exposition of 'Anokhi'] that through the tzaddik/divine agency one praises God equally in both names ('in YHVH I praise, in Elokim I praise'), all being 'He Who is good and does good'
tmp:2098: nitbatel malkhutam u-memshaltam shel ha-akum — the nullification of the kingship and dominion of the idolatrous nations (all exiles named after Egypt) through 'I am the Lord your God'
tmp:2099: nitbatel retzono mipnei retzon Hashem yitbarach — nullifying one's own will before God's will, the inner essence of fasting/tzedakah that annuls conflict and increases peace
tmp:2100: she-mafshitin u-mashlikhin me-aleihem ha-begadim ha-tzo'im — stripping off and casting away the 'filthy garments' (sins), whereby all barriers and screens dividing one from holiness are removed (damming the Jordan)
tmp:2102: nitbatlin ve-nikhna'in alufei Esav — the subduing and nullification of the chieftains/magnates of Esav via receiving the Torah ('alfei shin'an' read as she-einan, 'that they are not')
tmp:2103: histaklut al ha-takhlit — gazing at the ultimate purpose/end (as reaping is the goal of plowing), achieved by shutting the eyes to the sights of this world and focusing vision
tmp:2104: nitbatlin kol ha-yisurin — the nullification of all sufferings ('afflictions of the soul,' nig'ei ha-nefesh) attained by closing the eyes and directing one's gaze to the ultimate purpose
